sourceBrief: Create a memorable AutoPromote welcome film and social campaign from an idea alone, with no recorded footage. Show imagination becoming finished work, rather than a feature list.
prompt: Cinematic photograph of one tiny ivory origami paper sailboat with a sharply folded hull and one tall triangular sail, intact after a storm, floating on calm deep blue water. A spectacular narrow golden path of reflected dawn sunlight opens directly in front of the boat and leads toward a bright horizon. The boat is complete and occupies ten percent of frame, immense quiet sea and emotional relief, restrained photoreal amber and blue grading, crisp tactile paper, no words or logos.
